name: Top-20 Index
status: live on the NAV-tracker vault (QuadrixIndexVault, keeper/update-nav.mjs); the in-kind basket on QuadrixBasketVault v3.1 is prepared, not deployed (basket.vault null)

source.rulebook: quadrix/docs/methodology/qx20.md (site repo, private; draft — in force as implemented by keeper/update-nav.mjs)
source.implementation: keeper/update-nav.mjs — the model book is keeper/state.json, the mark ledger keeper/nav-marks.jsonl
source.note: This file describes qX20 as data so the basket keeper (keeper/basket-mark.mjs via paper-index.mjs --index qx20) can mark the qX20 basket from the same book update-nav.mjs marks the NAV tracker from. It does not drive update-nav.mjs, which keeps its constants in code.

universe.definition: the whole crypto market by circulating market cap; no sector, chain or issuer filter
universe.source: CoinGecko coins/markets top 60 (CoinPaprika top 80 fallback) in update-nav.mjs; top 500 in the basket leg (same feed, deeper page)
universe.exclusions: stablecoins and yield-bearing stables, wrapped and bridged representations, staking/restaking derivatives, LP tokens and vault shares, exchange tokens, tokenised RWA/money-market shares, PAXG — the EXCLUDE list in update-nav.mjs, matched by ticker

eligibility.note: none beyond rank and the exclusions — the rulebook draft proposes volume and listing-age floors; not implemented

rankBuffer.note: incumbents stay while rank <= 23; outsiders forced in at rank <= 17; seats filled to 20 by best rank

reconstitution.rule: first keeper run of each calendar month (UTC), no notice period — update-nav.mjs

driftBand.rule: between reconstitutions the book is re-weighted to target only when a constituent drifts more than 5 points from its cap-weighted target; checked every run (6h)

marking.basket: daily, after the paper-index run, by paper-index.mjs --index qx20; navPerShare = level / basket.navBase, stepped in <=14.9% moves; refPrice per constituent from the same CoinGecko snapshot

basket._doc: The on-chain basket for this index (QuadrixBasketVault v3.1 on GIWA Sepolia). vault/faucet null = not deployed: the keeper computes every mark and posts none. After a deploy (site repo .github/workflows/deploy-index-basket.yml) fill vault, faucet, assets {SYMBOL: {address, decimals}} in manifest order, and navBase = the index level on the deploy day (contracts/baskets/{index}.json navBase), so the first post is navPerShare 1.000000. keeper/basket-mark.mjs reads this block.
basket.navBaseNote: null until deployed — set to keeper/state.json level on the deploy day (the manifest records it as navBase); qX20 has no genesis-100 convention, its level is a NAV-like 1.0-based number
